digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge public API (library, MCP, CLI)
propositions: New typed library functions (bridge_preview, bridge_sync, bridge_status, bridge_pause, bridge_resume, bridge_check_access) must be exported from the public rebar module and reuse the shared run_pass/Disposition seam without duplicating reconciler logic

New MCP tools paralleling the typed library operations must register with explicit typed inputs/outputs and output schemas, while legacy reconcile(mode=...) and bridge_fsck tools retain their existing schemas and contracts

Legacy rebar.reconcile(mode=...) and rebar.bridge_fsck() must remain callable unchanged with their published defaults, accepted modes, return types, and exception behavior, mapped transparently to the new bridge operations

The mcp.allow_jira_sync gate must block every mutating route (bridge_sync, bridge_pause, bridge_resume, mutating reconcile modes) while allowing all read-only operations (preview, status, fsck, access-check)

Cross-surface semantic state and mutation outcomes must be identical between legacy library/MCP reconcile modes and their corresponding new bridge operations, proven through compatibility tests on real temporary repositories
